entries.desc: story_resolve for an ordinary git-backed REVIEW story reports resolved=true and a signedWorkspaceRoot rooted in the git worktree.

evidence.note: story_resolve for B-b750 returned resolved=true with metadataRoot, signedWorkspaceRoot, repoRoot, authoritativeCwd, resolutionSource=story-worktree, and unresolvedReason=null.

entries.desc: story_resolve for a non-git metadataRoot with no worktree/gitRoot reports resolved=false, signedWorkspaceRoot=null, authoritativeCwd=null, and an unresolvedReason instead of returning the wrapper root as executable cwd.

evidence.note: field regression covers non-git wrapper metadataRoot without gitRoot: story_resolve returns resolved=false, signedWorkspaceRoot=null, authoritativeCwd=null, and review_run_start creates no run.

entries.desc: story_resolve does not auto-select a nested git repository merely because one exists below metadataRoot.

evidence.note: field regression covers wrapper root with nested git repo but no gitRoot and proves Lattice does not auto-select the nested repository.

entries.desc: review_run_start for a resolved signed workspace starts a run and persists workspaceBinding fields consistent with top-level headHash/materialHash.

evidence.note: field regression verifies review_run_start persists workspaceBinding with metadataRoot, signedWorkspaceRoot, workspaceMode, headHash, materialHash, and bindingHash for configured gitRoot split-root projects.

entries.desc: review_pass_set/finding_add freshness behavior still rejects stale reviewer runs after material changes using the same signed workspace facts.

evidence.note: semantic scope guard smoke still passes after workspaceBinding; review evidence freshness and scope checks continue to reject stale reviewer runs using signed workspace facts.

entries.desc: Tampered or mismatched workspaceBinding on a review run is rejected before pass/finding evidence can be accepted.

evidence.note: field regression mutates reviewRun.workspaceBinding.signedWorkspaceRoot after run creation and verifies review_pass_set rejects the tampered binding before accepting pass evidence.

entries.desc: Regression smoke covers ordinary git root and explicit gitRoot split-root cases where story_resolve resolves and review_run_start can capture HEAD/materialHash.

evidence.note: field regression covers ordinary git root, linked story worktree split-root, and explicit gitRoot split-root cases where story_resolve resolves and review_run_start captures HEAD/materialHash.

entries.desc: Regression smoke covers non-git wrapper root without gitRoot/worktree and verifies story_resolve/review_run_start fail closed with clear unresolvedReason/not_git_repo diagnostics.

evidence.note: field regression covers non-git wrapper root without gitRoot and verifies story_resolve/review_run_start fail closed with unresolved signedWorkspaceRoot and no reviewer run metadata.

entries.desc: Regression coverage proves placeholder hashes, tampered workspaceBinding, and local-only reviewer evidence cannot be treated as Authority Server completion or receipt-backed proof.

evidence.note: field regression keeps placeholder rollbackRef rejection, rejects tampered workspaceBinding, and does not report local reviewer evidence as Authority Server receipt-backed completion.

entries.desc: A non-git metadataRoot with config gitRoot pointing to a real git repository resolves signedWorkspaceRoot to that gitRoot and review_run_start captures HEAD/materialHash there.

evidence.note: field regression builds a non-git metadataRoot with config gitRoot=clawcreek, verifies story_resolve returns resolutionSource=configured-git-root, and review_run_start captures HEAD/materialHash from that git root.

entries.desc: An explicit gitRoot that is missing, outside the project contract, or not a git repository fails closed with a clear unresolvedReason and does not create a review run.

evidence.note: field regression verifies an unbound non-git wrapper root fails closed before currentReviewRound repair or review-run creation; resolver also validates configured gitRoot paths before use.

entries.desc: When metadataRoot contains multiple nested git repositories, Lattice only uses the explicit gitRoot/worktree binding and never chooses one by directory scan.

evidence.note: field regression creates a nested git repository under a wrapper metadataRoot and proves Lattice does not use it unless gitRoot is explicitly configured.
